title: These 3 Richmond-area zip codes are among America's hottest for homebuyers: Redfin - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Nadeau ,
5 hours ago
RICHMOND, Va. (WRIC) — Three Richmond-area zip codes are among America’s hottest for homebuyers in 2026, according to new data from Redfin.
Redfin created a list of America’s Hottest Neighborhoods of 2026 by analyzing homebuying patterns within zip codes in the United States’ 100 most populous metro areas. Analysts looked at year-over-year growth in listing views on Redfin.com, as well as the zip code’s “Redfin Complete Score,” which is a measure of how hard it is to “win” a home in a particular area.
Three Virginia zip codes made the cut — and they’re all located in the Richmond metro area.
According to Redfin, the median sale price for a home in the Richmond region between January and February of this year is $395,000, which is up 1.4% year-over-year.
Here’s how its three “hottest” neighborhoods compare:
23236 Median house sale price : $385,000 (2.5% less than metro average) Change year-over-year : +2.7% Share of homes sold above list price : 31.6% Change in median views per home listing year-over-year : +14.1% 23060 Median house sale price : $419,364 (6.16% more than metro average) Change year-over-year : -2.4% Share of homes sold above list price : 21.8% Change in median views per home listing year-over-year : +22.7% 23112 Median house sale price : $420,000 (6.3% more than metro average) Change year-over-year : +2.4% Share of homes sold above list price : 32.1% Change in median views per home listing year-over-year : +14.9% You can find the full report here .
